cell_line.evidence: Here we compared BAG3 protein-protein interactions in either adherently cultured or stem-like cultured U251 GBM cells.

Applying a set of BAG3 deletion constructs we could demonstrate that none of the domains except the WW domain are required for suppression of cilia formation by full-length BAG3 in U251 and U343 cells.
